verses.text: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
lines: “Man, who is born of a woman,
is of few days, and full of trouble.

verses.text: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
lines: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down.
He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

verses.text: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
lines: Do you open your eyes on such a one,
and bring me into judgment with you?

verses.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
lines: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean?
Not one.

verses.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;
lines: Seeing his days are determined,
the number of his months is with you,
and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;

verses.text: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
lines: Look away from him, that he may rest,
until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

verses.text: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
lines: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down,
that it will sprout again,
that the tender branch of it will not cease.

verses.text: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
lines: Though its root grows old in the earth,
and its stock dies in the ground,

verses.text: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
lines: yet through the scent of water it will bud,
and sprout boughs like a plant.

verses.text: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
lines: But man dies, and is laid low.
Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

verses.text: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
lines: As the waters fail from the sea,
and the river wastes and dries up,

verses.text: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
lines: so man lies down and doesn’t rise.
Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake,
nor be roused out of their sleep.

verses.text: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
lines: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol,
that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past,
that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

verses.text: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
lines: If a man dies, will he live again?
I would wait all the days of my warfare,
until my release should come.

verses.text: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
lines: You would call, and I would answer you.
You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

verses.text: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
lines: But now you count my steps.
Don’t you watch over my sin?

verses.text: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
lines: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag.
You fasten up my iniquity.

verses.text: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place;
lines: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing.
The rock is removed out of its place;

verses.text: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
lines: The waters wear the stones.
The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth.
So you destroy the hope of man.

verses.text: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
lines: You forever prevail against him, and he departs.
You change his face, and send him away.

verses.text: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
lines: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it.
They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

verses.text: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
lines: But his flesh on him has pain,
and his soul within him mourns.”
